Schedule.description:
Schedule resources provide a container for time-slots that can be booked using an appointment. It provides the window of time (period) that slots are defined for and what type of appointments can be booked.
The schedule does not provide any information about actual appointments. This separation greatly assists where access to the appointments would not be permitted for security or privacy reasons, while still being able to determine if an appointment might be available.

Slot.description:
Slot resources are used to provide time-slots that can be booked using an appointment. They do not provide any information about 
    appointments that are available, just the time, and optionally what the time can be used for. These are effectively spaces of free/busy time.
Slots can also be marked as busy without having appointments associated.

schedule.description: The schedule resource that this slot defines an interval of status information

reference.description: The reference to the resource being referenced. Either relative or absolute URLs are allowed

type.description: The type of resource to the reference refers to

start.description: Date/Time that the slot is to begin

end.description: Date/Time that the slot is to conclude

overbooked.description: This slot has already been overbooked, appointments are unlikely to be accepted for this time

actor.description: This slot has already been overbooked, appointments are unlikely to be accepted for this time

reference.description: The reference to the resource being referenced. Either relative or absolute URLs are allowed

type.description: The type of resource to the reference refers to

comment.description: Comments on the slot to describe any extended information. Such as custom constraints on the slot
